; State returns: what the state rules share, and the dispatch from
; ReturnInputs.states to each state's rules.
;
; A state return starts from the federal one. California and Oregon both
; begin at federal adjusted gross income and conform to the federal filing
; status, so each state's rules take the prepared FederalReturn rather than
; working the federal figures out again.
(use-proto 'nexteggapp.taxprotos.us.state.ca.v1 'ca540)

(use-proto 'nexteggapp.taxprotos.us.state.or.v1 'or40)

; One band of a state rate schedule: taxable income from floor to ceiling is
; taxed at rate_bp basis points. The top band's ceiling is a sentinel far
; above any income.
(defstruct StateBracket (floor Money) (ceiling Money) (rate_bp Int))

; The tax on taxable income through a rate schedule, each band figured on its
; own and rounded to the cent, as the rate schedules print it. A state that
; rounds each band to a whole dollar, as Oregon does, says so.
;
; The rate is held in basis points and applied as (income * bp) / 10000, so
; the arithmetic is exact: a decimal rate such as 0.093 has no exact Float.
(def state-bracket-tax ((rows (Slice StateBracket)) (taxable Money) (whole-dollars Bool)) Money (withs (ti (clamp-zero taxable)) (sum (fn ((row StateBracket)) Money (withs (income (clamp-zero (- (min ti (. row 'ceiling)) (. row 'floor))) tax (round-cents (/ (* income (int-to-float (. row 'rate_bp))) 10000.0))) (if whole-dollars (round-dollar tax) tax))) rows)))

; The rate, in basis points, on the next dollar of taxable income.
(def state-marginal-rate-bp ((rows (Slice StateBracket)) (taxable Money)) Int (fold (fn ((acc Int) (row StateBracket)) Int (if (or (> taxable (. row 'floor)) (is (. row 'floor) #usd"0.00")) (. row 'rate_bp) acc)) 0 rows))

; State income tax withheld for one state, from every document that reports
; it: W-2 box 17, and the state boxes of Forms 1099-INT, 1099-DIV and 1099-R.
(def state-tax-withheld ((docs ret/Documents) (state String)) Money (withs (of-state (fn ((sws (Slice common/StateTaxWithholding))) Money (sum (fn ((sw common/StateTaxWithholding)) Money (if (is (. sw 'state) state) (. sw 'tax_withheld) #usd"0.00")) sws))) (+ (sum (fn ((w ret/W2Document)) Money (of-state (. w 'form.state_tax_withholding))) (. docs 'w2s)) (sum (fn ((d ret/Form1099INTDocument)) Money (of-state (. d 'form.state_tax_withholding))) (. docs 'interest)) (sum (fn ((d ret/Form1099DIVDocument)) Money (of-state (. d 'form.state_tax_withholding))) (. docs 'dividends)) (sum (fn ((d ret/Form1099RDocument)) Money (of-state (. d 'form.state_tax_withholding))) (. docs 'retirement_distributions)))))

; How many of the filer and, on a joint return, the spouse were 65 or older
; at the end of the year, and how many were blind. The federal standard
; deduction worksheet counts the same boxes.
(def state-senior-count ((hh ret/Household) (status fed/FilingStatus) (tax-year Int)) Int (+ (if (born-before-65-cutoff? (. hh 'taxpayer.date_of_birth) tax-year) 1 0) (if (and (state-joint? status) (born-before-65-cutoff? (. hh 'spouse.date_of_birth) tax-year)) 1 0)))

(def state-blind-count ((hh ret/Household) (status fed/FilingStatus)) Int (+ (if (. hh 'taxpayer.blind) 1 0) (if (and (state-joint? status) (. hh 'spouse.blind)) 1 0)))

(def state-joint? ((status fed/FilingStatus)) Bool (is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_JOINTLY))

; The dependents the federal return claims.
(def state-dependent-count ((hh ret/Household) (tax-year Int)) Int (len (keep (fn ((d ret/Dependent)) Bool (claimed-dependent? d tax-year (year-params tax-year))) (. hh 'dependents))))

; The age of the youngest claimed dependent at the end of the tax year, or 999 if none.
(def state-youngest-dependent-age ((hh ret/Household) (tax-year Int)) Int (fold (fn ((min-age Int) (d ret/Dependent)) Int (if (claimed-dependent? d tax-year (year-params tax-year)) (min min-age (person-age-end-of-year (. d 'date_of_birth) tax-year)) min-age)) 999 (. hh 'dependents)))

; Count of claimed dependent children age <= max-age at the end of the tax year.
(def state-young-children-count ((hh ret/Household) (max-age Int) (tax-year Int)) Int (len (keep (fn ((d ret/Dependent)) Bool (and (claimed-dependent? d tax-year (year-params tax-year)) (<= (person-age-end-of-year (. d 'date_of_birth) tax-year) max-age))) (. hh 'dependents))))

; The deduction a state return takes: the standard deduction, itemised
; deductions when the filer elects them, and otherwise the larger.
(def state-uses-itemized? ((election ret/DeductionMethodElection) (standard Money) (itemized Money)) Bool (cond ((is election 'ret/DEDUCTION_METHOD_ELECTION_ITEMIZED) true) ((is election 'ret/DEDUCTION_METHOD_ELECTION_STANDARD) false) (else (> itemized standard))))

(def state-deduction-election ((path String) (election ret/DeductionMethodElection) (used-itemized Bool) (standard Money) (itemized Money) (authority String)) ret/ResolvedElection (proto 'ret/ResolvedElection :election_path path :chosen_automatically (is election 'ret/DEDUCTION_METHOD_ELECTION_UNSPECIFIED) :chosen_option (if used-itemized "DEDUCTION_METHOD_ELECTION_ITEMIZED" "DEDUCTION_METHOD_ELECTION_STANDARD") :alternatives (slice (proto 'ret/Alternative :option "DEDUCTION_METHOD_ELECTION_STANDARD" :option_amount standard) (proto 'ret/Alternative :option "DEDUCTION_METHOD_ELECTION_ITEMIZED" :option_amount itemized)) :citations (slice (proto 'ret/Citation :authority authority))))

; A return is complete when nothing it reports is a warning or an error: an
; informational note says how a figure was reached, not that one is missing.
(def state-return-status ((diagnostics (Slice ret/Diagnostic))) ret/ReturnStatus (if (some (fn ((d ret/Diagnostic)) Bool (or (is (. d 'severity) 'ret/SEVERITY_WARNING) (is (. d 'severity) 'ret/SEVERITY_ERROR))) diagnostics) 'ret/RETURN_STATUS_INCOMPLETE 'ret/RETURN_STATUS_COMPLETE))

; Earned income for the standard deduction of a filer someone else can claim:
; wages, and net earnings from a business or farm less the deductible part of
; self-employment tax, as the federal Standard Deduction Worksheet for
; Dependents counts it. Both states point their dependent worksheets at the
; federal one.
(def state-earned-income ((fed-ret ret/FederalReturn)) Money :cite ("26 U.S.C. § 63(c)(5)" "Form 1040 Instructions, Standard Deduction Worksheet for Dependents") (withs (f (. fed-ret 'forms.form_1040) s1 (. fed-ret 'forms.schedule_1)) (clamp-zero (+ (. f 'total_wages) (clamp-zero (- (+ (. s1 'business_income_or_loss) (. s1 'farm_income_or_loss)) (. s1 'deductible_part_of_self_employment_tax)))))))

; The standard deduction of a filer someone else can claim: the larger of the
; minimum and earned income plus the addition, never more than the ordinary
; standard deduction.
(def state-dependent-standard-deduction ((earned Money) (minimum Money) (addition Money) (ordinary Money)) Money (min (max minimum (+ earned addition)) ordinary))

(def state-info ((code String) (message String) (authority String)) ret/Diagnostic (state-diagnostic code 'ret/SEVERITY_INFO message authority))

(def state-effective-rate ((tax Money) (income Money)) Float (if (> income #usd"0.00") (round-rate4 (/ tax income)) 0.0))

"taxcalcs"))))))) (. inputs 'states)))

; The return starts from the prepared federal return: federal AGI, the
; federal filing status, the federal tax liability, the federal Schedule A and
; the dependents the federal return claims. A part-year resident files Form
; OR-40-P and a non-resident Form OR-40-N, which are not computed here.
;
; The rules cite the law. The parts of the year's booklet and form they
; implement name them in sources/catalog/or.

(def or-claimable? ((hh ret/Household)) Bool (. hh 'taxpayer.can_be_claimed_as_dependent))

(def or-spouse-claimable? ((hh ret/Household) (status fed/FilingStatus)) Bool (all-of (state-joint? status) (. hh 'spouse.can_be_claimed_as_dependent)))

"316.685")) (bind f (. fed-ret 'forms.form_1040)) (bind s2 (. fed-ret 'forms.schedule_2)) (bind repaid (sum (fn ((i fed/Schedule2Item)) Money (if (is (. i 'description) "Excess advance premium tax credit repayment") (. i 'amount) #usd"0.00")) (. s2 'additions_to_tax))) (line 1 "Federal tax liability (Form 1040 line 22)" (. f 'tax_after_credits)) (line 2 "Excess advance premium tax credit repaid" repaid) (line 3 "Line 1 minus line 2" (clamp-zero (- line1 line2))) (line 4 "Other taxes from Schedule 2, lines 8, 16 and 17" (+ (. s2 'tax_on_iras_and_tax_favoured_accounts) (. s2 'recapture_of_low_income_housing_credit))) (line 5 "Line 3 plus line 4" (+ line3 line4)) (line 6 "American Opportunity credit (Form 1040 line 29)" (. f 'american_opportunity_credit)) (line 7 "Refundable adoption credit (Form 1040 line 30)" (. f 'refundable_adoption_credit)) (bind advance (sum doc-1095a-total-aptc (. docs 'marketplace_coverage))) (line 8 "Premium tax credit (Form 8962 line 24)" (clamp-zero (- (+ advance (. fed-ret 'forms.schedule_3.net_premium_tax_credit)) repaid))) (line 9 "Add lines 6, 7, and 8" (+ line6 line7 line8)) (line 10 "Line 5 minus line 9" (clamp-zero (- line5 line9))) (line 11 "Maximum allowable subtraction from Table 4" max-subtraction) (line 12 "Smaller of line 10 or line 11" (min line10 line11)) (result line12))

; The subtraction for federal tax: the liability, capped by the most allowed
; at the filer's federal AGI.
(def or-federal-tax-subtraction-limit ((tax-year Int) (status fed/FilingStatus) (federal-agi Money)) Money :cite ((law "Or. Rev. Stat." "316.680")) (fold (fn ((acc Money) (step SubtractionStep)) Money (if (>= federal-agi (. step 'at_least)) (. step 'maximum) acc)) #usd"0.00" (or-federal-tax-subtraction-steps tax-year status)))

"316.695")) (line 1 "Earned income" earned) (line 2 "Additional $450" addition) (line 3 "Add lines 1 and 2" (+ line1 line2)) (line 4 "Minimum standard deduction" minimum) (line 5 "Larger of line 3 or line 4" (max line3 line4)) (line 6 "Basic standard deduction for single" basic-single) (line 7 "Smaller of line 5 or line 6" (min line5 line6)) (line 8 "Age 65 addition" (if (> boxes 0) per-box #usd"0.00")) (line 9 "Blindness addition" #usd"0.00") (line 10 "Add lines 7, 8, and 9" (+ line7 (* per-box (int-to-float boxes)))) (result line10))
